what_it_is: PierSight Space is an Ahmedabad-based space startup building persistent maritime-domain-awareness satellites that combine SAR imaging with AIS ship-identification payloads. Founded by ex-ISRO engineers, it was selected by IN-SPACe for India's first private SAR constellation track and has raised seed funding reported around $6-8M from Indian and international investors.
india_angle: PierSight is a named beneficiary of India's IN-SPACe/ISRO opening for private SAR - a capability class previously government-only - targeting Indian Navy, coast guard and shipping surveillance needs such as oil-spill and vessel tracking. Its progress is a direct read on whether India's private sector can field sovereign SAR reconnaissance.
intelligence_assessment: Funding and selection milestones are verifiable, but no in-orbit SAR performance or defence customer contract is public yet. Watch the first flight-model SAR satellite launch and any MoD/Navy data-service agreements as the decisive validation points.

faq.a: SAR + AIS microsatellites for persistent maritime surveillance - vessel detection, tracking and oil-spill monitoring.

faq.q: Has PierSight been selected by IN-SPACe?
faq.a: The company states it was selected by IN-SPACe to build India's first private SAR constellation track.
Public trackers cite roughly $6-8M across seed rounds.
